notes.title: Patch Notes #2
notes.content:
[p][b]Enhancements:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Added option to change between Fullscreen/Windowed mode[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Changed Nailed Games logo in Splash Screen to the updated one[/p][/*][*][p][b]Changed Discoveries descriptions to enhance readability[/b][/p][/*][*][p][u][b]Changed Alchemy related costs - Alchemy can be utilized in early game[/b][/u][/p][/*][*][p]Updated Trajectory Line design - Changed design and animated motion[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated Resource Views - All resource views will show elements in Alphabetical order, for discovery there is an option to choose between highest to lowest price or alphabetical order[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Hover description for working moles - when mouse is over the mole in the bottom right corner it will show the name and current level of work[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610935/8a4878d58700d377762784365ece5fa4b2ac0a54.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Increase selling stack limits and tweak on Demand System to provide easier money generation in late game[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fixed bug related to Hook Mole was not able to correctly determine Mined Resources in the corners[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed bug about Foundry and Factory Learning Paths, now moles are able to reach highest stats[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collider issue related to Hook Tree, which showed the tree interactive even in cases where it wasn't[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Quest Reward scaling - synchronization was failing between quest scale tracker and elapsed time, which prevented correct quest reward scaling for late game.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: [p][b]Added option to change between Fullscreen/Windowed mode[/b][/p]

tags.balance_change: [p][u][b]Changed Alchemy related costs - Alchemy can be utilized in early game[/b][/u][/p]

tags.feature: [p]Updated Trajectory Line design - Changed design and animated motion[/p]
[p][b]Updated Resource Views - All resource views will show elements in Alphabetical order, for discovery there is an option to choose between highest to lowest price or alphabetical order[/b][/p]
[p][b]Added Hover description for working moles - when mouse is over the mole in the bottom right corner it will show the name and current level of work[/b]

tags.balance_change: [p][b]Increase selling stack limits and tweak on Demand System to provide easier money generation in late game[/b][/p]

tags.bug: [p][b]Fixed bug related to Hook Mole was not able to correctly determine Mined Resources in the corners[/b][/p]
[p][b]Fixed bug about Foundry and Factory Learning Paths, now moles are able to reach highest stats[/b][/p]
[p]Fixed collider issue related to Hook Tree, which showed the tree interactive even in cases where it wasn't[/p]
[p]Fixed Quest Reward scaling - synchronization was failing between quest scale tracker and elapsed time, which prevented correct quest reward scaling for late game.[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes #1 - Hotfix Update: Background Support Enabled
notes.content: I've implemented changes to allow the game to continue running in the background. With this update, you can now switch to other windows while your hardworking moles keep building and growing their economy without interruption.
